title: Topic 22
japanese_text:
Ａ：昨日逮捕した<u>連中</u>、何か分かりましたか。
Ｂ：それが、<u>裕福な</u>お年寄りばかりを狙って、かなり広い範囲で詐欺をやってたらしい。
Ａ：じゃあ、かなりの人数が<u>関与して</u>たんですか。
Ｂ：うん。メンバーは全国に<u>散らばって</u>いて、詐欺を行う者の<u>養成</u>までやってたとか。
english_translation: A: Did you find out anything about those guys arrested yesterday? B: It seems they were running a pretty widespread scam exclusively targeting wealthy elderly people. A: So there were quite a few people involved? B: Yeah. The members were scattered all over the country, and they were even training people to commit fraud.
